review_notes: I read the whole file and searched Mathlib/Analysis/CStarAlgebra for uses of toOrderEmbedding, map_le_map_iff and map_lt_map_iff. The only external use is a `rw [← NonUnitalStarAlgHom.map_le_map_iff ...]` in Commutative/PosPart.lean, so simp does not use these lemmas there. The file has no @[simp] attributes and no rewrite directions or competing rules that could loop. The lemmas map_le_map_iff, map_lt_map_iff, norm_map, nnnorm_map and isometry all need an `Function.Injective` hypothesis. Simp cannot discharge that hypothesis in general, so adding @[simp] would be unjustified under the rubric. The `simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]` inside toOrderEmbedding is local, and I found no downstream use that a @[simps] attribute would improve. I found no justified simp-interface defect. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out small gaps.
